title: MRKT - A terminal that not only provides institutional grade data but also explains every single
author: _gay_dicks420
selftext:
It's called MRKT and it's core principle is composed of two things:

**1. Provide access to institutional grade data**  
People think forex factory and other surface level free websites are all they need but there is so much you don't see it's actually no wonder traders typically get taken out with a loss by a move out of nowhere

For example every single data release only shows the "forecast" on these public calendars but markets (banks and institutions) pay attention to ranges instead of a single number

Those ranges vary for every single release but markets react the most to drops outside of these ranges

That's just an example, there is so much more you don't see I can not cover it all here just think live news headlines every other second, live repricing of central bank decisions, order flow shifts, etc.

**2. Provide the necessary context to actually be able to use that data every day**  
There are terminals out there, no doubt. The problem is they're only good in providing numbers and statements and you're on your own to figure out what it means in the current market while they simultaneously cost you a fortune every month

MRKT has trained their AI to explain EVERYTHING to the user, the second it comes out. Data drops get explained before they release and they know exactly how every scenario will impact your asset helping them prepare and lessen the chances of acting on emotions when price starts to move fast

We are dropping our own reworked bias engine soon bringing massive improvements to the first version which is already doing a fantastic job of greeting traders with a day bias composed of current market sentiment, recent developments and the underlying macro trend

https://preview.redd.it/x42rthgttwnh1.png?width=2771&format=png&auto=webp&s=593b10455f816a7a1cd9cbfcafa00bc5b43c89f1

The video from above is from the development of this new bias. Just a html file to work on ideas for UI implementation but getting closer and closer to a final product.

AI, engineering and data cost are huge but we're getting a steady stream of new users which makes it worth it.

Link to our site is below, we also showcase the platform every day with free trade ideas, updates and so forth on our official page on X [u/MRKT\_AI](https://x.com/MRKT_AI)

[mrktedge.ai](http://mrktedge.ai)

comments.author: kingomost
comments.body:
I’m interested in the engineering behind MRKT’s macro-event ingestion and AI context layer. My background includes stock-market applications, data-intensive backends and LLM/RAG systems.  
If ingestion reliability, source normalization or grounded explanations are a current bottleneck, I’d be open to a paid architecture/debugging sprint. Are you using a single provider or reconciling multiple sources?

comments.author: Annual-Tea102
comments.body:
While giving retail traders institutional data and real-time AI explanations is a powerful concept, relying entirely on AI to break down complex macro shifts and high-speed order flow live without hallucinations or lag remains a massive engineering hurdle.

How are you handling the latency challenge to ensure your AI explains fast-moving data drops before the market fully prices them in? Furthermore, financial data is notoriously messy and prone to gaps, how do you handle data cleaning and missing values to ensure bad data doesn't compromise the output?
